name: Mercenary Celestial Orbs
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Celestial Orbs (players/priest/mercenary/celestial_orb_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 2 (in brackets): beam damage 8 (12). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Three orbs follow Holy Light's target and fire beams for 8 magical damage.
